messages:
Samira Patel: FYI CVE-2026-0421 reported for grpc-native layer. Affects v1.9.x and v1.10.x. Need to decide backport cadence for Dedicated + Private (VPC/on-prem) customers — some cannot accept image repartitioning.

Jonah Reed: severity? exploitability? do we need emergency rollout or normal patch train?

DevSecBot: CVE-2026-0421 | High | RCE via malformed metadata | Affects grpc-native < 1.10.3. Fix committed: grpc-native@1.10.3. Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-0421

Priya Nair: TLDR: hosted customers can be migrated to 1.10.3 with blue/green. Dedicated customers on reserved images: some are pinned to custom customer-image tags. Private (air-gapped) customers need offline patch bundles.

Samira Patel: Constraints: 1) On-prem images can't change digest layout (customers validate manifest sigs). 2) VPC installs use our private registry mirror — we need signed manifests. 3) KMS rotations: if we change key usage in the runtime to accept new GRPC flags, ensure no breaking with HSM integrations.

Opsley: Proposal: create a 1.9.x-compat backport branch that cherry-picks the grpc fix + minimal surface changes. Build customer-artifact images with the same manifest schema. Tag format: `cust-YYYYMMDD-patch-<short-hash>`.

Jonah Reed: Sounds good. For Private/offline: produce a .tar.gz bundle with images + SBOM + detached signature. Customers can load via `docker load` or `ctr images import`. Add a README with verification steps.

Priya Nair: Checklist draft: 
- identify affected deploys (list by customer)
- create backport branch: `release/backport/grpc-2026-03`
- run CI with `INSECURE_SKIP_PUSH=false` to validate signed manifests
- build artifacts with `IMAGE_LAYOUT=v2` to preserve manifest shape
- produce SBOM (spdx/cyclone) and detached sig via cosign
- create patch PRs for Dedicated config + image pin docs
- schedule canary with 2 low-risk Dedicated tenants

Samira Patel: Important: KMS integration note — the fix touches GRPC metadata parsing which our KMS client wraps. We must run key rotation smoke before canary. @Priya can you own KMS regression test?

Priya Nair: I can. I'll add tests: 
- key unwrap/unwrap happy path (local HSM emu)
- rotate active key and validate existing tokens continue to decrypt
- exercise mutual TLS + grpc metadata edge case.

DevSecBot: Suggested urgency: P1 for public exploit in the wild, otherwise P2. Current exploit reports: 2 unconfirmed PoCs. Recommend coordinated patch within 48h for hosted and 7 days for Dedicated/private with customer notifications.

Opsley: Customer-facing notes: 
- For Dedicated: we will push new image tags; if customers pin digests we will offer signed image bundles.
- For Private air-gapped: offline bundle + install guide + verification steps.
- For VPC mirror customers: mirror will have 1.10.3 by default; customers with strict whitelists must request image hashes.

Jonah Reed: Action items: 
- @Opsley: prepare offline bundles and SBOMs (due in 24h)
- @Samira: draft customer comms for Dedicated & Private (24h)
- @Priya: KMS regression suite and canary validation (48h)
- @Jonah: run backport branch CI and coordinate canary (48h)

Priya Nair: small technical note — when cherry-picking, avoid pulling in the new API surface for channel credentials. Use `git cherry-pick -x <commit>` and then run `make deps-lock` to keep vendored deps stable.

Samira Patel: Also: add a note in deployment runbook about manifest verification when re-signing images in customer-managed registries. Some customers validate `Content-Type` headers in registry responses and will fail if layout changes.

Opsley: I'll open a skeleton GH release: `backport/grpc-2026-03` with attached artifacts when ready. Will tag customers needing manual push.

Jonah Reed: One more: add a temporary gateway rule to route traffic to a fallback runtime (compat mode) if the new image fails grpc init. Fallback window 30m then roll back.

Samira Patel: thanks everyone. Summarizing: we treat this as high priority, backport branch + offline bundles + KMS regression + staged canary. I'll create an incident channel and ping affected SEs. :lock:

DevSecBot: Incident channel created: #incident/grpc-0421-2026-03

Opsley: I'll upload initial SBOM + sample `tar.gz` by EOD to the release draft.

Priya Nair: For traceability, log all image hash changes in audit log: `audit.img_update` with fields: customer_id, old_digest, new_digest, operator. I'll add the event schema to the runbook.

Samira Patel: Perfect. Closing thread for now — followups in #incident/grpc-0421-2026-03.
